lead.title: Pakistan squad announced for England Test series
lead.summary: Pakistan have picked a 15-man group for the home Test series. Two newcomers are in the squad while a senior bowler misses out.

secondary.title: Bumrah, Pant in India squad for New Zealand Test series
secondary.summary: Bumrah is not part of the ODI squad, but will return to lead the attack in the two-match Test series

secondary.title: New AI model beats rivals on coding benchmarks
secondary.summary: A new AI model has topped several public coding tests, according to its developers. Independent researchers say more testing is needed.

secondary.title: State Bank holds interest rate steady as inflation eases
secondary.summary: The central bank kept its policy interest rate unchanged. Officials said inflation is cooling but risks remain.

stories.title: Pakistani startup raises seed funding for farm logistics
stories.summary: A young company building cold-chain logistics for farmers has closed a seed funding round. It plans to expand to three new regions.

stories.title: Anthropic proposes law regulating AI to US lawmakers
stories.summary: Anthropic, the creator of the AI assistant Claude, confirmed on Friday it is circulating a draft bill among US lawmakers aimed at regulating artificial intelligence to address the lack of federal legislation on the risks posed by the new technology.

stories.title: Chip maker Nvidia shares climb as AI demand stays strong
stories.summary: Shares rose after the company said demand for AI chips remains high. Investors are watching supply limits closely.

stories.title: Leaders gather for summit on sanctions and trade
stories.summary: Heads of government met to discuss sanctions policy and trade rules. A joint statement is expected on the final day.

stories.title: Jayawardene steps down as Mumbai Indians head coach
stories.summary: "Mumbai Indians has been a very special part of my journey for over a decade now," Jayawardene said

stories.title: Fraser-McGurk 49-ball ton, McSweeny ton, Johnson five in SA victory
stories.summary: Fraser-McGurk smashed an Australian record 14-ball List A fifty on his way to 122 from 63 while McSweeney also made 106, with Johnson taking five wickets as SA beat Queensland

stories.title: Any miscalculation by adversaries will invite response beyond their ‘imagination, calculation’, warns CNSC
stories.summary: Commander National Strategic Command (CNSC) General Aamer Raza warned the country’s adversaries on Saturday that “any miscalculation will be met with a response far beyond the imagination or the calculation of the initiator”.

stories.title: Oregon teacher fought school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
stories.summary: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.

stories.title: Ceasefire talks resume as United Nations urges aid access
stories.summary: Negotiators returned to the table as the United Nations pressed for safe aid routes. Officials described the talks as difficult.
